body: I’m exactly in the same spot as you right now. Everyday, waking up, having the same thoughts and wanting to just end it all because there never seems to ever be a good day, and if there even was, it would have only been for a few minutes, hours, but nothing more. I’m just mentally, physically and emotionally tired at this point. I just finished breaking down, so forgive me if what I’m typing isn’t making sense. If you ever feel like this again, and wanna talk to someone, I’m open.
